Today, I’m exploring Salar de Uyuni in Bolivia, the world’s largest salt flat—a place where a thin layer of water can turn the ground into an enormous mirror, reflecting the sky above!
Located in southwestern Bolivia, South America, Salar de Uyuni stretches across more than 10,000 square kilometres on the Altiplano, the high plateau of the Andes. At roughly 3,650 metres above sea level, this vast white landscape has a very different setting from an ordinary desert.
